project_identity.app_type: Hybrid Fullstack Sports Video Analysis Dashboard & Tactical Annotation Tool
project_identity.emotional_tone: Tactical Precision, High-Performance Athletic, Clean & Authoritative
project_identity.description: Uma plataforma de alta performance visual para análise tática de partidas de voleibol, marcação sobre vídeo, dossiê individual de atletas e geração de relatórios estatísticos da AVA.

monospace_data.use_case: Timestamps, Match clock, Efficiency Percentages, Frame Numbers, Drawing coordinates

colors.palette_mode: Balanced Red & Black Tactical Theme (Dark Mode Default + Light Mode Support)

layout_and_grids.spacing_philosophy: Generous tactical spacing (p-6, p-8 for containers) with zero component collision.
layout_and_grids.border_radius: rounded-xl for cards, rounded-lg for buttons/inputs, rounded-full for status badges and quick pills.
layout_and_grids.home_dashboard_grid: Base grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Featured 'Analyze Video' card spans 2 columns with primary red outline glow.
layout_and_grids.video_workspace_layout: Split-screen flex/grid layout: 70% video player & drawing canvas on left, 30% pause-to-mark tagging panel and live timeline log on right. Fully responsive stack for tablets/mobile.
layout_and_grids.gallery_grid: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4 gap-6 with search bar & filter chips sticky header.

home_panel.header_banner: Displays 'AVA - Associação Voleibol Assisense' with official badge logo, quick team metrics (Partidas Analisadas, Marcações Totais, Atleta Destaque da Semana), and Theme Switcher.

action_cards.title: Adicionar Vídeo
action_cards.subtitle: Upload de novo arquivo de jogo ou treino MP4/WebM

video_workspace.player: Custom HTML5 Video Player with Play/Pause, 0.25x/0.5x/1x speed control, Frame-by-frame forward/backward, current timestamp display.
video_workspace.annotation_canvas: Canvas overlay with drawing modes: Seta (Arrow), Texto (Text), Circulo/Forma (Shape), Trajetória da Bola (Curved Trajectory Path). Supports color picker (Red, Yellow, Green, White), line weight selector, and clear/undo.
video_workspace.pause_to_mark_panel: Instant tag registration form: Timestamp auto-populated, Select Fundamento (Saque, Recepção, Levantamento, Ataque, Bloqueio, Defesa), Select Classificação (##, +, !, -, =), Select Atleta (Number & Name), and Tag Note.
video_workspace.tag_timeline_feed: Scrollable list of registered tags synced to video playback with clickable timestamps to seek directly.

video_gallery.filters: Search by title/opponent, Filter by Status (Todos, Pendente, Em Análise, Concluído), Sort by Date.
video_gallery.video_card: Video thumbnail with play overlay, duration badge, match title, competition, status badge (Pendente = Amber, Em Análise = Blue, Concluído = Green), tag count.

athlete_folders.roster_list: Filter by position (Ponteiro, Oposto, Central, Levantador, Líbero). Athlete card with photo, jersey number, name, position, total tags count.
athlete_folders.profile_dossier: Individual statistics modal/page showing radar chart of fundamentals, percentage of positive actions, video clips tagged with this athlete, and coach notes.

reports_and_charts.collective_stats: Eficácia de Ataque (%), Eficiência de Saque, Índice de Recepção Perfeita (A+B), Pontos de Bloqueio por Set.
reports_and_charts.visualizations: Pie charts for Fundamentos distribution, Bar charts for Classificação breakdown by athlete, Recharts responsive containers.
reports_and_charts.export_panel: Export buttons for PDF Report, CSV Raw Data, and High-Res PNG Chart image.

configurable_settings.custom_fundamentos: Ability to add/edit custom fundamentos and default keyboard shortcuts (e.g., 'S' for Saque, 'A' for Ataque).
configurable_settings.custom_classifications: Configure rating scale labels and colors.

instructions_to_main_agent.code_language: JavaScript (.js and .jsx files). Do NOT output TypeScript .tsx files.
instructions_to_main_agent.testing_attributes: EVERY interactive element (button, link, input, tab, card, modal toggle, playback button, canvas tool button) MUST include a unique data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='nav-home-button', data-testid='tag-fundamento-saque-btn', data-testid='video-play-pause-btn').
instructions_to_main_agent.no_transparent_overlays: Dropdowns, modals, and tooltips MUST have solid/semi-solid opaque backgrounds with backdrop-blur (e.g., bg-slate-900/95 or bg-white/95) to prevent text overlap readability issues.
instructions_to_main_agent.accessibility: Ensure text contrast ratio meets WCAG AA standard. Use aria-labels for video control buttons and drawing tool icons.
instructions_to_main_agent.state_persistence: Store videos, athlete list, tags, custom settings, and reports in React state with localStorage pre-filled with high-quality realistic AVA Volleyball mock data so the app feels completely alive out of the box.
